runs.text_head:
**IE3 means "Premium Efficiency."** It is one of the motor efficiency classes defined in **IEC 60034-30-1**, the international standard for line-operated AC motors, mostly 3-phase induction motors.

**The scale:**

| Class | Name |
|---|---|
| IE1 | Standard efficiency |
| IE2 | High efficiency |
